fo.title: Failover
fo.hint: A linked server that mirrors this one: change stuff on either and the other copies it.
fo.needsOnline: It has to be online first
fo.sheetIntro: This server and {name} will stay synced both ways, seconds after every change. Here's what syncs:
fo.notYet: Each server keeps its own addresses, disks, data folder, certificates and history. Files can sync too: pick folders on the Failover page once it's on.
fo.space: Settings take about {size} on the other server.
fo.primaryTitle: Whose settings win the first sync?
fo.primarySelfHint: {name}'s accounts and settings get swapped for this server's.
fo.primaryPeerHint: This server's accounts and settings get swapped for {name}'s.
fo.bothAgree: An admin on {name} has to say yes before anything syncs.
fo.catHint.sharing: shared folders, who gets in, network drives
fo.catHint.backups: backup spots, plans and cloud imports
fo.catHint.settings: server settings, scripts, AI providers, remote connections
fo.primaryIsSelf: This server led the first sync
fo.hAsked: Waiting for an admin on {name} to say yes.
fo.hAsking: {name} wants this server as its failover buddy.
fo.hStartingPrimary: {name} is grabbing this server's accounts and settings.
fo.hStarting: This server is grabbing {name}'s accounts and settings.
fo.hPaused: Sync is paused here. Changes wait till you resume.
fo.hFailing: The last few syncs flopped. Changes wait till the servers reach each other again.
fo.hBehind: No sync for over a minute. Still trying.
fo.hOk: Both servers have the same accounts and settings.
fo.acceptMsgSelf: {name} takes this server's accounts and settings, then both stay synced.
fo.acceptMsgPeer: This server's accounts and settings get replaced by {name}'s, then both stay synced. Accounts only on this server get removed.
fo.declineMsg: {name} gets told. It can ask again later.
fo.offMsg: No more syncing. Both keep what they've got. {name} gets told and stops too.
fo.conflictsHint: These got changed here and on {name} before they synced. Newest one is live for now; pick the keeper.
fo.hiddenDiff: Only hidden stuff (like passwords) is different.
fo.filesHint: Pick the folders that sync. Files sync as they change, checksums and all; deleted stuff lands in the other server's recycle bin, and a file changed on both keeps both versions. App data for a running app waits till the app stops.
fo.outsideWindow: Files only sync between {from} and {to}; settings sync whenever.
fo.kind.appdata: App data, sent while each app is stopped
fo.kind.config: Container stacks and Shield DNS settings, always synced
fo.filesSpace: The other server needs about {size} free for these folders.
fo.windowHint: Leave the times empty to sync files whenever. Sync now ignores the schedule.
fo.filesSaved: File sync updated on both servers
